name: General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679
note: GDPR compliance belongs to the controller and the processor. passmcp produces inputs for the record of processing (Art. 30) and the DPIA (Art. 35), and evidences the technical side of security of processing (Art. 32).

criteria.title: Data minimisation
criteria.reason: Whether the controller collects only the personal data it needs is a property of its purposes, not of a server's behaviour. passmcp's own minimisation (redaction, no telemetry) is documented in the manual.

criteria.title: Data protection by design and by default
Processor
criteria.reason: Contracts between controller and processor are legal documents, not server behaviour.

criteria.title: Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority
criteria.reason: Breach notification is an organisational process.
